manifest.author: RAPP
manifest.description: Introspects any .egg cartridge (local path or URL) and routes it by manifest schema/type to hatch, install, or mount; refuses unknown kinds.

distinct_from.@kody-w/twin_egg_hatcher: That agent builds one twin from a repo, a folder or an egg. This one opens any kind of egg, checks every file against the egg's label, and routes it by kind.

manifest.name: @rapp/egg_hatcher

egg_path.description: Local file path (e.g. /Volumes/usb/dad.egg, ~/Downloads/foo.egg) or HTTP/HTTPS URL to a .egg cartridge.
